title: Rejected by 18 Girls: The Return of the Dragon King
description: After being rejected and humiliated by eighteen girls who used his power to become wealthy, the Dragon King returns to reclaim his destiny and seek vengeance. A tale of betrayal, ancient bloodlines, and the rise of a legend.

episodes.title: The Birth of the Dragon Son

parts.text: My mother was simply washing her hair by the riverbank when suddenly, the Dragon King, spiraling between the sky and the water, caught sight of her. He didn't wait for a single moment; without seeking permission, he forcibly seized her and whisked her away to his Dragon Palace. It all happened so fast that she didn't even have a chance to comprehend it. Then, something bizarre occurred: in less than half a month, my mother gave birth to a child. Initially, she was overjoyed, believing she would become the most powerful mother in the dragon world. But the Dragon King was consumed by rage. He imprisoned her beneath the water and coldly declared that once the Dragon Child was born, he would devour it to increase his own power. Devastated but determined, my mother refused to give up. On the day I was born, she gathered her last bit of strength and fled from the Yellow River, carrying me through the rushing waters until she reached an injured green snake on the shore.

parts.text: The snake was so weak she couldn't even save herself, but my mother pleaded with her: 'Please, save my son. He is a Dragon Child. He will surely repay your kindness when he grows up.' With those final words, my mother's strength vanished, and she was swallowed by the depths of the Yellow River, leaving no trace behind. I was left alone until the injured green snake emerged from the water, shook her body, and transformed into a girl. She picked me up; her name was Liu Ruoli, and she would eventually become my master. That very night, she spread the news to the world that a Dragon Child had been born. A massive stir followed; it was said that whoever possessed the Dragon Child would lead a life of supreme success. Only a girl born on Phoenix Day could bond with the Dragon Child. The next day, thousands gathered outside my master's house, each hoping their daughter would be the one to form a contract with me. Finally, my master chose eighteen girls, making a small cut on my finger to form a contract with each of them.

parts.text: That night, all the girls were told to stay with me. Outside, lightning flashed and a storm roared like a madman. The Yellow River crashed against its banks like a wild beast, the sound of the wind and rain terrifying. Yet, in the presence of these girls, I fell into a peaceful sleep. The next morning, my master bid the girls farewell, telling their families that from this day on, they would excel in every field. However, she warned that this luck would only last for eighteen years, after which one of them must marry her disciple, or calamity would strike. Her prophecy came true; the lives of the eighteen girls changed overnight. One won a lottery of 500 million yuan, another received massive government compensation. Every family became wealthy instantly. But my master was not happy; she knew this joy was temporary. Then came the most terrifying day of my life. On the night of my eighth birthday, the clear sky suddenly turned pitch black. Fierce winds and thunder shook the courtyard. My master buried seven copper coins in the ground, burned paper money, and turned to me.

parts.text: She told me that after tonight, I would be eight years old. For the next ten years, I would have to spend each year living with one of those girls. 'If you survive, you live; otherwise, it's the end,' she said. She revealed the truth: 'You are the Dragon Son. Once the Dragon King senses your presence, he will hunt you down and devour you.' For eight years, she had hidden my Dragon Qi using the Yin energy of the Phoenix girls, but her power was fading. She had to go into seclusion, and I would have to navigate the path ahead alone. Suddenly, she knelt before me, fear in her eyes for the first time. She explained that my eyes were beginning the Golden Dragon Awakening, but I was still defenseless. I had to pretend to be blind—a technique called 'Self-Covering.' She gave me sunglasses and the addresses of the girls. That night, she looked at me deeply one last time before her body slowly turned transparent and vanished into the darkness, leaving me alone in a world where death waited at every step.

Only sixteen then, she was incredibly beautiful but possessed a royal, arrogant air. During my stay, she never even bothered to look at me directly, treating me like a pet. She refused to share a bed and forbade me from even touching her belongings.

episodes.title: The Burden of the Blind Beggar

parts.text: Because she thought I was blind, she would order me to massage her feet and bring her towels. If she felt the slightest dissatisfaction, she would deny me food, sleep, or even entry into the house. When my year there ended and I stepped across the threshold to leave, she set off firecrackers in celebration. The sound of those crackers pierced my heart like needles. I was filled with rage and sorrow, finally understanding what it meant to be truly discarded. In the following years, I was met with nothing but contempt at every house. They looked at me as if I were a piece of trash. While their words weren't always foul, their gestures and behavior made it clear they considered me a burden. Amidst this cold treatment, I mastered every skill my master had taught me, and the power hidden within me began to stir. Yet, my master had strictly forbidden me from using it, for the moment I did, the truth would be revealed—that I wasn't blind.

parts.text: And at that moment, the Dragon King would catch my scent and find me. Having power but being unable to use it was a guilt that ate at me for ten years. Finally, the time came when I was about to turn eighteen, and I had to go to the last house. The girl's name was Su Mengyao. Her family had become giants in the real estate industry, and she herself was a popular star. She treated me carelessly because she was certain I was blind and posed no threat. She even began bringing her arrogant, wealthy boyfriend home, deliberately flaunting her affection for him in front of me to ignore me, confident I couldn't see a thing. One night, they even crossed the line, becoming intimate right in front of me for excitement. The boy laughed and said, 'This blind guy...'

translations.hi:
ड्रैगन किंग मेरी सेंट पकड़ कर मुझे ढूंढ

लेता। मेरे पास पावर होते हुए भी मैं उसे

यूज नहीं कर सकता था। यह गिल्ट मुझे पूरे

10 साल तक अंदर से खाता रहा। फिर आखिरकार

वह समय आया जब मैं 18 साल का होने वाला था

और मुझे आखिरी घर में जाना था। उस लड़की

parts.text: I clenched my fists in anger, wanting to end it all, but I remained silent. I endured the three most difficult years of my life until finally, the one-year deadline arrived. This was the final year of protection from the eighteen Phoenix girls. If I wanted to survive, I had to marry one of them by tonight. At eighteen, I returned to my village and prepared the house for a wedding—decorating with red silk and lighting the Dragon-Phoenix candles. But my heart was filled with fear and despair. Over the last eighteen years, I had seen their true faces, and I doubted any of them would be willing to marry me. If none agreed, the Dragon King would come at midnight to devour me. Suddenly, a familiar figure appeared—it was my Master, Liu Ruoli. She looked exactly as she had before—young and beautiful—but her body was now half-transparent, as if a gust of wind could blow her away. She smiled softly and said, 'My little boy has grown up. It's good to see you like this.'

translations.hi:
मैंने गुस्से में अपनी मुट्ठियां भी ली।

मुझे यकीन नहीं था कि उनमें से एक भी

उसका शरीर अब आधा ट्रांसपेरेंट था। जैसे

हवा का एक झोंका उसे उड़ा सकता हो। वो

धीरे से मेरे पास आई। मेरी वेडिंग ड्रेस

को देखा और हल्की सी मुस्कान के साथ बोली,

"मेरा छोटा बच्चा अब बड़ा हो गया है।

तुम्हें इस रूप में देखकर अच्छा लग रहा

parts.text: She gently smoothed the wrinkles in my clothes and said, 'I came here out of concern for you. I left seclusion just to see you.' She then told me she would summon all eighteen girls, and I could choose any one of them. I asked fearfully, 'Master, even if I choose them, will they agree to marry me?' She placed a hand on my shoulder and said, 'Don't worry. If they are wise, they should be begging to marry you to repay their old debt.' When I asked what would happen if they refused, she whispered with a mysterious smile, 'If they don't agree, find your own way to make them willing. Don't embarrass me.' Her words made me blush, unsure of what she meant, but I felt that whatever was coming would change my life forever. Master looked at me with deep concern and pain before handing me a small pouch.

translations.hi:
है। उसने प्यार से मेरे कपड़ों की सिलवटें

ठीक की और कहा, "मैं तुम्हारी चिंता में

उसने कहा, अब मैं उन सभी 18 लड़कियों को

यहां बुलाऊंगी। तुम उनमें से जिसे चाहो

अगर मैं उन्हें चुन भी लूं, क्या वह मुझसे

शादी करने के लिए तैयार होंगी? उसने बहुत

नरमी से मेरे कंधे पर हाथ रखा और कहा,

चिंता मत करो। अगर वह समझदार हैं तो

उन्हें खुद तुमसे शादी करने की भीख मांगनी

चाहिए ताकि वह अपने पुराने कर्ज को चुका

सके। मैंने फिर भी हिचकिचाते हुए पूछा और

अगर वह मना कर दें तो इस बार वह हल्का सा

मुस्कुराई। मेरे कान के पास आई और धीरे से

फुसफुसाई। अगर वह नहीं माने तो तुम खुद

उसके यह शब्द सुनकर मेरा चेहरा लाल हो

जिंदगी बदल देगा। मैंने धीरे से अपना सिर

झुका लिया। मास्टर मेरी तरफ देख रही थी।

बाद आखिरकार उन्होंने एक छोटा सा पाउच

parts.text: She told me in a low voice, 'If they truly refuse to marry you, open this—but only as a last resort. I fear you may not be able to bear it.' After touching my face one last time, she took the card with the names and left. I called out to her, pleading not to use her power if they refused, but she was already gone. I was left alone in the courtyard, waiting for nightfall. Every moment felt heavy until finally, the sound of horns echoed in the distance. Eighteen luxury cars pulled up outside my broken courtyard. One by one, eighteen beautiful, confident women stepped out. I quickly put on my sunglasses and continued my act of being blind.

निकाला और मेरे हाथ में रख दिया। धीमी

होने का इंतजार करने लगा। समय जैसे रुक

episodes.description: Years of humiliation and the final countdown to the Dragon King's arrival.

episodes.title: The Marriage Proposal

parts.text: As the eighteen girls entered the courtyard, the atmosphere shifted instantly. A strange fragrance filled the air, tinged with the scent of smoke and burning. Strangest of all, each girl carried a black plastic bag. Bai Tingting, in her blue skirt, still looked as cold and arrogant as the day she forced me to massage her feet. Su Mengyao, in her purple skirt and black coat, exuded wealth and pride; she was the one who had truly betrayed me, and I vowed never to choose her. Wang Changchang, in her red fur coat, looked shy but I remembered her cruelty—leaving me in the middle of the road as a child, hoping a car would hit me. Some stood in simple white dresses, their expressions filled with the same elitist pride. Just as I was about to decide, Su Mengyao spoke up.

translations.hi:
रखा। मैं चुपचाप उन्हें ऑब्जर्व कर रहा

था। जैसे ही वह सभी आंगन में दाखिल हुई,

parts.text: Su Mengyao smiled mockingly at Bai Tingting and said, 'Tingting, your legs are so long; you could be a walking stick for that cripple. Why don't you marry him?' The other girls burst into laughter, their mockery stinging my heart. It was clear none of them wanted anything to do with me. I felt myself breaking inside until Bai Tingting snapped, 'Enough, Su Mengyao! We must remember our past. When we were children, we all went to the wedding hall with Chen An. If he chooses one of us, it is his right.' I was stunned—the girl who treated me like a pet was now defending me. But the others remained defiant. One girl declared, 'What right? This isn't the old days. I refuse to accept him as a husband; he is nothing to me.' Bai Tingting fired back, 'Has your conscience died? Everything we have—this luxury, these cars—is because of that contract. We cannot be this ungrateful!'

translations.hi:
सुमेंग्याऊ ने मुस्कुराते हुए बाय

टिंगटिंग की तरफ देखा और ताना मारा।

टिंगटिंग सिस्टर तुम्हारी लेग्स इतनी लंबी

हैं। तुम उस क्रिपल के लिए वॉकिंग स्टिक

बन सकती हो। क्यों ना तुम ही उससे शादी कर

लो। उसकी यह बात सुनते ही बाकी सभी

लड़कियां जोर से हंसने लगी। उनकी हंसी

मेरे दिल में चुभ रही थी। साफ था कि वह

कोई भी मुझसे शादी नहीं करना चाहती थी।

parts.text: The elegant ladies looked at me with pure disgust. Some laughed, some joked. But in that moment, I felt something else. Their faces were full of joy, but their fates were coming to an end. An inner voice told me that tonight, it wasn't just I who would die—they would all perish, though they had no idea. Bai Tingting looked the most triumphant, as if she had won a great victory. I looked up at the sky; it was filled with heavy clouds, the air thick with tension. Was the Dragon King already here? My hand went to the pouch my Master had given me. She told me not to open it, but I had no choice. Bai Tingting spoke again, 'We've returned your blood. Now, if you're smart, end the engagement.' I kicked the bags away and shouted, 'I want nothing from you! Take it all and get out! But know this—if I don't survive tonight, none of you will!'

Inside was a red Marriage Certificate. On one side was my birth date, and on the other was another date—but it wasn't a Phoenix date. I didn't understand. Suddenly, a bright light flashed in the sky, and a powerful, commanding voice echoed: 'Who dares to refuse marriage tonight?' A terrifying pressure descended on the courtyard. Bai Tingting’s legs gave out, and she collapsed under the weight. I looked up and saw a beautiful figure in a green dress standing on the roof. It was my Master, Liu Ruoli. parts.text: Wang Changchang stammered, 'Master Liu, it's not like that. He's just a blind man. How can we marry him?' The other girls chimed in, saying it wasn't certain I'd even survive the night. Liu Ruoli’s face hardened, and she shouted, 'Silence!' Her hands moved, and a whirlwind of dust knocked the girls to the ground. They cowered in fear but said nothing. I saw Master’s transparent body trembling; her power was fading. I stepped forward to protect her. 'Master, if they don't want to, let them be. We don't need them.' I turned to the girls and said firmly, 'Master has found the 19th Phoenix girl for me, and she is a thousand times better than any of you. Tomorrow, when you come begging, it will be too late.' Bai Tingting and Su Mengyao laughed, 'Oh, so there's a backup? Then we have nothing to worry about.'

parts.text: The other girls looked between fear and relief. Afraid they might regret it later, they all rushed to their cars and sped away. I watched them leave, noticing that the golden light of their luck was being replaced by a dark, ominous smoke—a clear sign of their impending downfall. Silence finally returned to the courtyard. Before I could speak, Liu Ruoli’s body weakened, and she fell from the roof. I caught her, and as she looked at me, her sharp eyes softened with an affection I had never seen. She reached out with a cold hand and wiped a smudge from my cheek. She smiled weakly and said, 'Crazy boy. Now I finally see how much you love your Master.' I stood there holding the Marriage Letter, my throat dry. I asked softly, 'Master, about the eight characters on this letter...'

parts.text: I told her I just wanted to make them angry, but she leaned in and whispered, 'Actually, there is no 19th girl. Now tell me, are you afraid?' I looked at her and said, 'No, I'm not afraid. Even if the Dragon King devours me, I will never bow to them.' A soft smile played on her lips. Suddenly, lightning cracked and heavy rain began to fall. Was the Dragon King here? She looked at the sky and quickly pulled me inside the house, locking all the doors and windows. Her eyes were now incredibly tender, filled with warmth. She asked softly, 'Since none of them want to marry you, will you marry me?' I was completely shocked. The Marriage Letter... was the other birth date hers? Was she not a Phoenix girl, but a snake spirit? I was speechless. She smiled and asked, 'What's wrong?'

As the blood flowed, she immediately took my finger into her mouth. I froze, a strange heat rushing through my body. I turned my face away in embarrassment. Now, my Dragon Blood had entered her body. She bandaged my finger and looked outside; her face grew serious again. It was pitch black, the wind howling, and the sound of a Dragon Bell echoed in the distance. She smiled at me. 'Now we are truly husband and wife. Ready?' My heart pounded.

parts.text: I wanted to give her more warmth, but she suddenly pushed me away gently and turned on the light. I stood there confused, wondering if I wasn't worthy. She smiled softly and said seriously, 'You are still in a mortal body. Your power is too low; if we proceed now, you won't be able to bear it.' I realized the real game was just beginning. He warned me that if I didn't act quickly, the Dragon King would kill me.

episodes.description: The Dragon King reveals himself to his first rejector.

episodes.title: The Abyss and the Shadow

parts.text: I smiled faintly, slowly removed my mask, and revealed my golden Dragon Eyes. 'My dear fiances, don't you recognize me?' The hall exploded in shock. 'Chen An? How is this possible? You're supposed to be dead!' Wang Changchang’s face turned pale. Su Mengyao jumped as if someone had stepped on her tail. 'Bai Tingting, are you crazy? You conspired with him to trap us?' I descended the stairs slowly and said, 'Trap you? Eighteen years ago, you took my Dragon Blood. Eighteen years later, you insulted me and broke the contract in front of everyone. Now it's time to return the principal with interest.' As I moved forward, the Dragon Aura from my body grew heavier, making them struggle to breathe. Suddenly, the chandelier began to flicker, and a strange electrical sound filled the air. Some girls screamed in terror, but Su Mengyao still shouted, 'Don't be afraid! He's just trying to scare us. Let's get out of here!' They ran for the door, but it wouldn't budge. Fierce winds began to blow outside, and the windows shattered. The red lanterns outside suddenly turned green, and countless white faces pressed against the glass.

parts.text: Their empty eyes peered inside, filling the atmosphere with terror. I stood in the center and said, 'This game is called Ghost House. Ever since you eighteen Phoenix girls broke the contract, bad karma has clung to you. When you gather together, these wandering souls are attracted to you.' Su Mengyao’s legs gave out, and she collapsed. The other girls panicked. I looked at them with cold eyes and said, 'Without my Dragon Blood, you are the perfect prey for them.' I whispered, 'Before, I used to request you, and you thought yourselves so high. Now the times have changed. Now, you will beg me.' They were all silent, paralyzed by fear. After a while, one girl gathered the courage to ask, 'Chen An, if we marry you every year, can we escape this trouble?' I laughed softly. 'Now you remember the contract? You didn't think of it when you broke it. Now you want to renew? Isn't it too late?' Terrified, she asked, 'Then what do you want?' I replied coldly, 'I don't know what I want. It depends on what you're willing to give.' They fell silent, unsure of what to do.

parts.text: But then Su Mengyao stepped forward and shouted to everyone, 'Don't be afraid! Don't forget that he needs something from us too!' She claimed that if no one married me tonight, the Dragon King would devour me after midnight. Hearing this, a flicker of hope—or rather, cunning—returned to their faces. One said, 'She's right. Why should we fear him? He should be the one fearing us!' Su Mengyao smiled at me confidently, 'Sisters, we just need to stay united. No one will marry him. Tonight will be his last night. Then, he'll be the one begging us on his knees to renew the contract.' Seeing her self-confidence, I laughed. I felt both anger and amusement. I casually fanned myself and sat on the central sofa. 'It seems the game is getting interesting. Fine, let's see who begs whom in the end.' I paused and said softly, 'But remember one thing—if I marry even one of you, I can live for another year and save her from this disaster. But as for the other seventeen... I can't guarantee anything.'

parts.text: My words changed the atmosphere instantly. Those who were talking about staying united now looked at each other with suspicion and fear. The truth was clear: if one girl stepped forward to choose me, she would be saved, while the others could perish. Their pride was now turned against them. Suddenly, Wang Changchang was the first to rush forward. She knelt directly before me and grabbed my leg. 'Brother Chen An, I'm ready to marry you! I've never loved anyone; I'm innocent. If you choose me, I'll always listen to you. I'll even call you Master.' Seeing this, Su Mengyao shouted in anger, 'Wang Changchang, have you no shame?' But Wang Changchang replied with a cold look, 'Su Mengyao, don't play drama. We have to marry him after the contract is renewed anyway, so what difference does it make if it's a year earlier or later? And he's not even blind—what's the problem with marrying him?' Hearing this, the other girls lost control. 'Move, I was here first!' 'Chen An, my family has lots of money; I'll give it all to you!' 'Choose me! I'll sacrifice everything!'

parts.text: In moments, the hall turned into chaos. The girls who were standing with Su Mengyao were now fighting each other for me. parts.text: Countless people were standing there with empty eyes, staring inside as if waiting for a signal. The silence was unnatural, carrying the weight of impending doom. I felt as if I had entered a terrifying new world. My mind went into panic mode as I looked around. In seconds, the sounds of the villa—the cleaning, the wind, the storm—all ceased. Everything turned into an unnatural silence. I realized something was wrong; it wasn't possible for so many ghosts to retreat in an instant. A great danger was present. My heart raced as I counted the people in the hall: 1, 2, 3... 16, and Bai Tingting. Only 17 people. My eyes narrowed, my control wavering. I shouted for everyone to be quiet. The hall fell silent. I grabbed Bai Tingting’s hand and asked, 'Where is the 18th Phoenix girl? Who is she? Why didn't she come?' Bai Tingting trembled and said, 'She's Anran. She didn't reply to my messages or calls. I thought she just didn't want to come.'

parts.text: The name Anran made me freeze for a moment. Images of her flashed in my mind—she was the one among the eighteen who was different, who never said a bad word about me. I had even thought that if I had to choose one, it would be her. But she wasn't here. Suddenly, a terrifying Dragon Roar echoed from the sky. The entire villa shook violently, and the lights flickered. Su Mengyao fell to the floor in terror, and the others hid behind me. I was in shock when the villa door opened on its own. A mysterious figure walked in. It was Anran, but she was no longer the simple, quiet girl I knew. She wore a red robe with black dragon patterns, her long hair flowing, and her face cold and arrogant. Her eyes held a strange defiance, as if challenging the world. She said coldly, 'My mother signed a contract. She enjoyed its power, so she should pay the price. Why should I?' She raised her hand, and the air seemed to freeze. I watched in horror as the skin of the other seventeen girls began to turn white, as if their life energy were being drained.

parts.text: A shadow emerged behind Anran, swallowing the sounds of the hall. My heart sank—it was the Dragon King of the Yellow River. I finally understood: Anran had made a deal with the Dragon King to save herself, becoming his puppet. Anran laughed, but it wasn't her voice—two voices merged, hers and another's. 'My dear child, thanks for gathering all these nutrients for me. Tonight, I will devour you all and reclaim my body. I will become a true Dragon.' Why did you go to fight him so soon?' She smiled and added, 'But my husband has grown up now. He won't be easily fooled by any girl.' Her words didn't bring relief; my heart only grew more anxious. 'Master, run! He came to kill me. Why put yourself in danger? You saved me once; there's no need for more sacrifice.' parts.text: Her smile was incredibly beautiful. 'Last time, I saved you because I was struggling with cold poison and your body's warmth gave me relief. That was a deal. But this time, things are different.' I asked desperately, 'How? If you die, what difference does it make?' She stepped forward and took my face in both hands. Looking into my eyes, she asked softly, 'What did you just call me?' I answered without thinking, 'Master.' she immediately shook her head. 'Wrong. You don't know... the nature of a snake is true love. Once they choose someone, they stay with them for life.' Before I could speak, a loud laugh echoed from the sky. The Black Dragon rose again, his eyes filled with bloodlust. 'I thought a great god had arrived, but it's just a failed snake who couldn't even become a dragon. A worm-like thing dares to fight me? Today, I will devour you too!' Blood and tears shone in Liu Ruoli’s eyes. She let go of my face and turned to the Black Dragon, killing intent erupting from her. 'If you touch my husband, there will be war.' She transformed into her dragon form in a flash and flew toward the sky.

parts.text: She collided with the Black Dragon, the impact echoing through the sky. Lightning flashed, and clouds seemed to burst. With every clash, red light spread through the heavens, as if the world were ending. But slowly, the Black Dragon’s roar began to overpower her. With a massive roar, Liu Ruoli fell from the sky and crashed before me. Blood flowed from her mouth. Terrified, I ran and caught her in my arms. Her face was pale, her breathing heavy. In the sky, the Black Dragon swirled, his voice echoing like thunder: 'See? This is fate. A snake will always be a snake; it can never become a dragon. And you, my son, placed your hope in a useless snake demon. You have disappointed me.' I held Liu Ruoli tighter, my eyes burning with rage and pain. My heart felt like it was being sliced, my breathing heavy as I felt the cold Dragon Blood flowing in my veins. I whispered to her, 'Ruoli, thanks for protecting me. You always wanted to be a dragon, didn't you? Today, I will make you a dragon myself.'

parts.text: I forcefully activated all the meridians in my body and gathered all the Dragon Blood in my heart. Without a moment's hesitation, I spat out my heart's blood and injected it directly into Liu Ruoli's body. 'No!' she screamed as she felt it, but it was too late. A brilliant golden light erupted from me and entered her. I felt my life energy draining rapidly, my strong body instantly weakening. The Dragon Blood that had been with me since birth was gone, replaced by a deep, cold energy. I realized then that I was no longer a normal human, but a rare existence. In the midst of the golden light, Liu Ruoli's body exploded and transformed into a giant Green Snake. But then a miracle happened: her green scales slowly turned silver-white, four sharp claws grew from her body, and long dragon horns emerged from her head. A magnificent Silver-White Dragon rose into the sky. In that moment, the world's colors changed, everything bowing before her. For the first time, fear was clear on the Black Dragon's face. 'How is this possible? A snake becoming a real Dragon?'

parts.text: He tried to flee, but the Silver Dragon opened its mouth and released a terrifying Dragon Breath that stopped him instantly. Then, distorting space, she appeared above him in a flash and struck with her massive claws. The Black Dragon's body shattered into black smoke and vanished into the clouds. Colorful clouds filled the sky as if a divine presence had arrived. But at that moment, my strength was completely gone. My body went limp, and I began to fall. A warm energy caught me. Liu Ruoli immediately returned to her human form. She pressed her forehead to mine, a soft, damp feeling on my lips and a warm stream flowing through my body. Her soft voice echoed in my ears: 'Honey, sleep peacefully now.' That was the last voice I heard before I lost consciousness. Some time later, I slowly opened my eyes. I was lying in my bed, sunlight streaming through the window. By the bedside were a letter and the Marriage Contract. With trembling hands, I opened the letter; it was in Liu Ruoli’s handwriting: 'Honey, when you read this letter...'
